summary: Lithuania is an EU and Schengen member: EU/EFTA citizens enter freely, nationals of the countries and territories on the EU's visa-exempt list (as of 30 December 2025) can stay 90 days in any 180-day period, and everyone else needs a €90 Schengen visa. The UK government says only one border crossing with Belarus remains open.

fee.text: Applicants shall pay a visa fee of EUR 90.

processing.text: That period may be extended up to a maximum of 45 calendar days in individual cases, notably when further scrutiny of the application is needed.

stayDays.text: This Regulation establishes the procedures and conditions for issuing visas for intended stays on the territory of the Member States not exceeding 90 days in any 180-day period.

extendable.text: The period of validity and/or the duration of stay of an issued visa shall be extended where the competent authority of a Member State considers that a visa holder has provided proof of force majeure or humanitarian reasons preventing him from leaving the territory of the Member States before the expiry of the period of validity of or the duration of stay authorised by the visa. Such an extension shall be granted free of charge. 2. The period of validity and/or the duration of stay of an issued visa may be extended if the visa holder provides proof of serious personal reasons justifying the extension of the period of validity or the duration of stay.

extendable.text: The period of validity and/or the duration of stay of an issued visa shall be extended where the competent authority of a Member State considers that a visa holder has provided proof of force majeure or humanitarian reasons preventing him from leaving the territory of the Member States before the expiry of the period of validity of or the duration of stay authorised by the visa. Such an extension shall be granted free of charge. 2. The period of validity and/or the duration of stay of an issued visa may be extended if the visa holder provides proof of serious personal reasons justifying the extension of the period of validity or the duration of stay.

tips.text: The UK government says only one crossing point with Belarus remains open, Medininkai–Kamenny Log, and only by private vehicle, and that Russian-plated vehicles may enter only for up to 24 hours in transit to or from Kaliningrad. Canada says Lithuania enforces an EU entry ban on vehicles with Russian or Belarusian plates, with exceptions.

The Curonian Spit is divided between Lithuania and Russia's Kaliningrad region. The UK government warns that walking along the Lithuanian part will eventually reach Russian territory, and Canada says the Nida border-crossing point is closed.
Once ETIAS starts, the EU says applications are made on the official ETIAS website or the official ETIAS mobile app; it is not yet in operation.

faq.question: Do I need a visa for Lithuania?
faq.answer: EU and EFTA citizens enter freely. Nationals of the countries and territories on the EU's visa-exempt list (as of 30 December 2025), among them US, UK, Canadian and Japanese citizens, can stay up to 90 days in any 180-day period across the Schengen Area (ETIAS is not yet in operation). Everyone else needs a Schengen short-stay visa from the Lithuanian mission serving their place of residence.

faq.question: Can Russian citizens enter Lithuania?
faq.answer: Russian citizens need a Schengen short-stay visa (Regulation (EU) 2018/1806, Annex I). Lithuania's Foreign Ministry says that under Law No XIV-1888 its visa authorities abroad have suspended accepting Schengen visa applications from Russian and Belarusian citizens, except where the Ministry mediates the application, for example for family members of Lithuanian or EU citizens or for trips that cannot be postponed. The European Commission says that since 7 November 2025 Russian nationals no longer receive multiple-entry visas.

faq.question: How much does a Lithuania Schengen visa cost?
faq.answer: The Schengen short-stay visa costs €90 for adults and €45 for children aged 6–11. The Migration Department lists a €140 fee for examining a national long-stay (Type D) visa application.

faq.question: Is ETIAS required to enter Lithuania?
faq.answer: ETIAS for visa-exempt travelers across the Schengen Area is not yet in operation, and no applications are being collected; the EU will announce the start date several months before launch. Once in operation, the €20 travel authorization will be required for visa-exempt travelers to enter.

faq.question: Can I cross into Lithuania from Belarus?
faq.answer: Only with difficulty. The UK government says only one crossing point remains open, Medininkai–Kamenny Log, and only by private vehicle — scheduled buses are not running — and Lithuania denies entry to Belarus-registered cars, with some exemptions.
